mapper.insert: INSERT INTO proj_project_stage_snapshot (project_id, stage_code, snapshot_no, operation_type, before_stage, after_stage, before_lifecycle_status, after_lifecycle_status, before_assignment_status, after_assignment_status, reason_code, reason_detail, reassignment_requirement, business_basis, legacy_items_json, guard_snapshot_json, tree_version, provider_facts_json, related_snapshot_id, operation_id, operator_user_id, operated_at, creator, create_time, updater, update_time, deleted, tenant_id) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{stageCode}, #{snapshotNo}, #{operationType}, #{beforeStage}, #{afterStage}, #{beforeLifecycleStatus}, #{afterLifecycleStatus}, #{beforeAssignmentStatus}, #{afterAssignmentStatus}, #{reasonCode}, #{reasonDetail}, #{reassignmentRequirement}, #{businessBasis}, #{legacyItemsJson}, #{guardSnapshotJson}, #{treeVersion}, #{providerFactsJson}, #{relatedSnapshotId}, #{operationId}, #{operatorUserId}, #{operatedAt}, #{creator}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{updater}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, b'0', #{tenantId})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM proj_project_stage_snapshot WHERE ORDER BY operated_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{query.limit} OFFSET #{query.offset}

SELECT close_snapshot.* FROM proj_project_stage_snapshot close_snapshot LEFT JOIN proj_project_stage_snapshot reopen_snapshot ON reopen_snapshot.tenant_id = close_snapshot.tenant_id AND reopen_snapshot.project_id = close_snapshot.project_id AND reopen_snapshot.operation_type = 'REOPEN' AND reopen_snapshot.related_snapshot_id = close_snapshot.id AND reopen_snapshot.deleted = b'0' WHERE close_snapshot.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND close_snapshot.project_id = #{query.projectId} AND close_snapshot.operation_type = 'EXCEPTION_CLOSE' AND close_snapshot.deleted = b'0' AND reopen_snapshot.id IS NULL ORDER BY close_snapshot.operated_at DESC, close_snapshot.id DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
